title: Okay chair.
text:
Okay chair.. Delivered quickly, went together easy. Only problem is comfort. Seat is very hard,
needs more padding, but is easy to fix with a chair pad. Relative to price paid, its
alright for a kid or smaller person, adult man..will need a chair pad for long sitting.

product_metadata.title: Flash Furniture High Back Black Leather and Mesh Executive Swivel Chair with Arms
features: High Back Design with Leather Headrest
description: This split leather and mesh office chair provides a professional appearance to complement your office or home. Mesh office chairs can keep you more productive throughout your work day with its comfort and ventilated design. The breathable mesh material allows air to circulate to keep you cool while sitting. High back office chairs have backs extending to the upper back for greater support. The high back design relieves tension in the lower back, preventing long term strain. The waterfall front seat edge removes pressure from the lower legs and improves circulation. Chair easily swivels 360 degrees to get the maximum use of your workspace without strain. The pneumatic adjustment lever will allow you to easily adjust the seat to your desired height.
